grid.projection: Lambert conformal conic, lon0 82°E, lat0 24°N, standard parallels 12.47°N/35.17°N, sphere R=6371 km; units km

water.name: Land
water.rule: At least half of the hex's ~73 sample points fall inside the Survey of India outline (India) or a Natural Earth country (neighbours). Each state, UT and district gets at least one hex.

water.name: Ocean
water.rule: Sea hex with mean depth below 200 m (AWS Terrain Tiles bathymetry) and no land neighbour.

water.name: Coast
water.rule: Sea hex next to a land hex, or shallower than 200 m.

water.name: Lake
water.rule: Hex inside India where Natural Earth 1:10m lakes cover at least half of the sample points.

relief.name: Flat
relief.rule: Standard deviation of elevation inside the hex under 90 m.

relief.name: Mountains
relief.rule: Elevation standard deviation ≥ 300 m, or mean elevation ≥ 2,500 m.

relief.name: High peaks
relief.rule: Mean elevation ≥ 4,500 m (high Himalaya, Karakoram, Ladakh ranges).

cover.name: Rainforest
cover.rule: Forest classes (IGBP 1–5) are the largest group and evergreen broadleaf (2) is the largest forest class.

cover.name: Forest
cover.rule: Forest classes are the largest group, not mostly evergreen broadleaf.

cover.name: Woodland
cover.rule: Woody savanna (8) is the largest group.

cover.name: Grassland
cover.rule: Savanna (9) plus grassland (10) is the largest group.

cover.name: Scrub
cover.rule: Shrubland (6, 7) is the largest group and annual rain is ≥ 350 mm.

cover.name: Farmland
cover.rule: Cropland (12) plus cropland/natural mosaic (14) is the largest group.

cover.name: Floodplain
cover.rule: Farmland on flat relief with a major river (Natural Earth scale rank ≤ 6) within 0.6 hex radius of the centre.

cover.name: Wetland & mangrove
cover.rule: Permanent wetland (11) is the largest group.

cover.name: Desert
cover.rule: Barren (16) is the largest group, or shrubland with annual rain under 350 mm (WorldClim 2.1).

cover.name: Cold desert
cover.rule: Barren, shrub or grass dominant and mean elevation ≥ 3,000 m.

cover.name: Snow & ice
cover.rule: Permanent snow and ice (15) is the largest group.

cover.name: Urban
cover.rule: Urban and built-up land (13) covers ≥ 20% of the hex, whatever else is there.
